skill.summary: 将文本报告转换为可视化组件流。当用户需要将报告数据可视化或提到"可视化报告"、"用图表展示"、"图文并茂"时使用。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of report-to-visualization skill.

- Converts text reports into visual component flows using strict MODULE format.
- Supports Line, Column, Pie, List, DataCard, TextCard, KeyValueCard, PhaseCard, TimelineCard, AlertCard, and InfluenceCard components.
- Provides detailed criteria and formatting rules for each visualization type, ensuring data integrity and display clarity.
- Designed for Chinese-language reports and visualization requirements.
